required_controls: case work-unit and attempt limits are checked before protected admission
token-unit tool-quota and time reservations are bounded hierarchically
refund records retain reservation identity and cannot exceed remaining reservation
budget exhaustion produces a typed terminal stop and prevents retry
fallback reservations use the same remaining budget and cannot overrun it
SLO observation reports deterministic reservation/refund/stop counts without model or tool execution
trace_persistence_boundary: M5.5 keeps deterministic in-process budget ledger/SLO observations. Durable metrics, alerting and event streaming remain M5.8 responsibilities.
